units.korean-k7-unit: Hadalka aan toos ahayn iyo xiriiriyeyaasha isku dhafan
units.korean-k8-unit: Ixtiraamka sax ah iyo codka falka

korean-k1-l1.title: Shaqalada aasaasiga ah
korean-k1-l1.concept: Hangul waa alifbeetada Kuuriyaanka. Dhawaaq kasta waa xubin. Shaqal keliya waxaa lagu qoraa **ㅇ** ka hor, kaas oo bilowga aamusan: 아 waa “a” oo keliya.

korean-k1-l2.title: Shibbanayaasha aasaasiga ah
korean-k1-l2.concept: Shibbane ku hor dhig shaqal si aad u sameyso xubin dhawaaq: **ㄱ + ㅏ = 가** (ga). Xubinta ka akhri bidix ilaa midig.

korean-k1-l3.title: Erayada ugu horreeya
korean-k1-l3.concept: Xubnaha dhawaaqa isku xir si aad erayo u sameyso. Xubin kasta akhri, kadibna wada dheh.

korean-k1-l4.title: Shaqalada Y
korean-k1-l4.concept: Ku darista xariiq gaaban waxay samaysaa cod **y**: ㅏ → ㅑ (ya), ㅓ → ㅕ (yeo), ㅗ → ㅛ (yo), ㅜ → ㅠ (yu). ㅐ (ae) iyo ㅔ (e) waxay u egyihiin si aad u isku dhow Kuuriyaanka casriga ah.
korean-k1-l4.example: 야 · 여 · 요 · 유 (ya · yeo · yo · yu)

korean-k1-l5.title: Shibbane kale
korean-k1-l5.concept: ㄹ waxay u dhaxeysaa “r” iyo “l”. ㅈ (j), ㅊ (ch, oo hawo la socota), ㅋ (k, oo hawo la socota), ㅌ (t, oo hawo la socota) iyo ㅍ (p, oo hawo la socota) waxay dhammaystiraan shibbanayaasha aasaasiga ah.
korean-k1-l5.example: 라 · 자 · 차 · 카 · 타 · 파 (ra · ja · cha · ka · ta · pa)

korean-k1-l6.title: Shibbanayaasha labaanlaaban
korean-k1-l6.concept: ㄲ, ㄸ, ㅃ, ㅆ iyo ㅉ waa codad adag: ku dheh dhuun adag oo aan hawo la socon, sida codka ugu horreeya ee “skate”.
korean-k1-l6.example: 까 · 따 · 빠 · 싸 · 짜 (kka · tta · ppa · ssa · jja)

korean-k1-l7.title: Shibbanayaasha dambe
korean-k1-l7.concept: Shibbane ka hooseeya xubinta dhawaaqa waxaa loo yaqaan **받침 (batchim)**. Wuxuu xidhaa xubinta: 안 (an), 말 (mal), 밤 (bam), 강 (gang), 집 (jip), 책 (chaek). Kaliya todobo cod ayaa suurtagal ah dhammaadka: ㄱ ㄴ ㄷ ㄹ ㅁ ㅂ ㅇ.
korean-k1-l7.example: 안 · 말 · 밤 · 강 · 집 (an · mal · bam · gang · jip)

korean-k1-l8.title: Erayada maalinlaha ah
korean-k1-l8.concept: Akhri eray kasta dhawaaq-dhawaaq. 학교 waxaa loo akhriyaa “hakgyo”: ㄱ-ga dambe ee 학 waa xiran yahay, dhawaaqa xigana si adag ayaa loo dhawaaqaa.

korean-k1-l9.title: Erayada ku saabsan adduunka
korean-k1-l9.concept: Dadka iyo dabeecadda: 사람 (qof), 나라 (dal), 하늘 (cir), 산 (buur), 강 (webi), 꽃 (ubax).

korean-k10-l1.title: Madax-xariifyada iyo qaab kooban
korean-k10-l1.concept: Madax-xariifyada wararka iyo weedhaha magac ee kooban: 물가 안정 대책 발표.
korean-k10-l1.example: 물가 안정 대책을 발표했습니다. (mulga anjeong daechaegeul balpyohaesseumnida.) = waxaa la shaaciyay tallaabooyin xasilinta qiimaha

korean-k10-l2.title: Arrimaha hadda iyo tafaasiirta tifaftirka
korean-k10-l2.concept: Akhrinta maqaallo gaaban oo wararka ah: 친환경 에너지가 주목받고 있습니다.
korean-k10-l2.example: 친환경 에너지가 주목받고 있습니다. (chinhwan-gyeong eneojiga jumokbatgo isseumnida.) = tamar nadiif ah ayaa caan noqotay

korean-k10-l3.title: Hadallada xikmadda ee qaybaha jidhka (발, 눈, 귀, 손)
korean-k10-l3.concept: Hadallo xikmadeed oo caadi ah oo qaybaha jidhka ah: 발이 넓다 (shabakad ballaaran), 눈이 높다 (heer sare).
korean-k10-l3.example: 김 대리는 발이 넓어요. (gim daerineun bari neobeoyo.) = xiriirro ballaaran ayuu leeyahay / 눈이 높아요. (nuni nopayo.) = heerar sare ayuu dooranayaa

korean-k10-l4.title: Hadallada xikmadda ee ficillada maalinlaha ah (바가지, 어깨)
korean-k10-l4.concept: Hadallo loogu talagalay xaalado caadi ah: 바가지를 쓰다 (la khiyaaneeyay qiimaha), 어깨가 무겁다 (waajib culus).
korean-k10-l4.example: 바가지를 썼어요. (bagajireul sseosseoyo.) = qiimo la khiyaaneeyay / 어깨가 무거워요. (eokkaega mugeowoyo.) = culeys mas'uuliyadeed

korean-k10-l5.title: Maahmaahyada Kuuriyaanka muhiimka ah
korean-k10-l5.concept: Xikmad maahmaah ah: 소 잃고 외양간 고친다, 쇠뿔도 단김에 빼라.
korean-k10-l5.example: 소 잃고 외양간 고친다. (so ilko oeyanggan gochinda.) = xerada dayactir ka dib lumitaanka lo'da / 쇠뿔도 단김에 빼라. (soeppuldo dangime ppaera.) = ku dhufo inta birtu kulushahay

korean-k10-l6.title: Hadallada afar xaraf (사자성어)
korean-k10-l6.concept: Hadallo caadi ah oo afar xaraf ah oo laga soo qaatay Shiinaha: 일석이조, 작심삼일, 다다익선.
korean-k10-l6.example: 일석이조예요. (ilseogijoyeyo.) = laba shimbir hal dhagax / 작심삼일이에요. (jaksimsamirieyo.) = go'aanka saddex maalmood

korean-k10-l7.title: Isku xirayaasha macquulka ah iyo calaamadaha hadalka
korean-k10-l7.concept: Calaamadaha hadalka rasmiga ah: -에 따르면, 한편, 요컨대, 따라서.
korean-k10-l7.example: 의견에 따르면 그렇습니다. (uigyone ttareumyeon geureotsseumnida.) = sida aragtida ay sheegayso / 한편 다른 측면도 있습니다. (hanpyeon dareun cheungmyeondo isseumnida.) = dhinaca kale, waxaa jira dhinac kale

korean-k10-l8.title: Qiyamka iyo caadooyinka dhaqanka qoto dheer ee Kuuriya
korean-k10-l8.concept: Fikradaha dhaqanka iyo caadooyinka ciidaha: 따뜻한 정, 송편을 빚다.
korean-k10-l8.example: 따뜻한 정이 있어요. (ttatteutan jeongi isseoyo.) = jeong diirran (jacayl) / 송편을 빚어요. (songpyeoneul bijeoyo.) = samee songpyeon chuseok

korean-k10-l9.title: Dib-u-eegis dhammaystiran ee K10
korean-k10-l9.concept: Hanashada dhaqanka Kuuriya, warbaahinta, maahmaahyada iyo odhaahyada doodda rasmiga ah.
korean-k10-l9.example: 일석이조의 효과를 거두었어요. (ilseogijoui hyogwareul geoduosseoyo.) = helay saameyn laba shimbirood hal dhagax / 상호 이해를 바탕으로 협력해요. (sangho ihaereul batangeuro hyeomnyeokaeyo.) = iskaashi ku salaysan isfaham

korean-k2-l1.title: Salaan iyo mahadnaq
korean-k2-l1.concept: Salaamaha edebta leh waxay ku dhammaadaan **-요** ama **-니다**. 안녕하세요 waxay shaqaysaa waqti kasta oo maalinta ah.

korean-k2-l10.title: Calaamadaha aad arki doonto
korean-k2-l10.concept: Calaamado gaagaaban ayaa meel walba ka jira Kuuriya. **입구** waa laga soo galo, **출구** waa laga baxo, **화장실** waa suuli. Albaabbada, **미세요** waxay ka dhigan tahay riix **당기세요** waxay ka dhigan tahay jiid.

korean-k2-l11.title: Mahadsanid cuntada
korean-k2-l11.concept: Intaadan cuntaysan dheh **잘 먹겠습니다**, markaad dhammayso dheh **잘 먹었습니다**. Marti-qaade ayaa kugu soo dhaweeya **어서 오세요**, **맛있어요** waxay ku ammaanaysaa cuntada.
korean-k2-l11.example: 잘 먹겠습니다. (jal meokgetseumnida.) = Waxaa la yiraahdaa intaan la cunin: “Si fiican ayaan u cuni doonaa.” / 잘 먹었습니다. (jal meogeotseumnida.) = Waxaa la yiraahdaa marka la cuno: “Si fiican ayaan u cunay.”

korean-k2-l2.title: Haa, maya iyo ok
korean-k2-l2.concept: Jawaabo gaagaaban oo edeb leh oo aad maalin kasta isticmaali karto. Kuuriyaanku wuxuu dhammaadka ku daraa **요** si uu u noqdo edeb.

korean-k2-l3.title: Waan ku faraxsanahay kulankaaga
korean-k2-l3.concept: Marka aad la kulanto qof cusub, dheh 만나서 반갑습니다. Waxaa jira laba siyaabood oo nabad-geliyo loo yiraahdo: mid qofka ka tagaya, mid qofka joogaya.
korean-k2-l3.example: 만나서 반갑습니다. (mannaseo bangapseumnida.) = Waan ku faraxsanahay kulankaaga.

korean-k2-l4.title: Odhaahyo edeb leh
korean-k2-l4.concept: Isticmaal 실례합니다 si aad u soo jiidato dareenka qof ama aad u dhaafto, 고마워요 si saaxiibtinimo ah loogu mahadnaqo, 천만에요 si loogu jawaabo mahadnaqa, iyo 축하해요 si loogu hambalyeeyo.

korean-k2-l5.title: Magacyada iyo wadamada
korean-k2-l5.concept: Weydii magac adigoo isticmaalaya 이름이 뭐예요? iyo wadan adigoo isticmaalaya 어느 나라 사람이에요? Ku jawaab 제 이름은 ___예요 ama 저는 ___ 사람이에요.
korean-k2-l5.example: 이름이 뭐예요? (ireumi mwoyeyo?) = Yaa lagu magacaabaa?

korean-k2-l6.title: Nabadgelyo ku dhawaaqista
korean-k2-l6.concept: Saaxiibbada dhexdooda waxaad ku dhihi kartaa 잘 가요 (nabadgelyo), 내일 봐요 (berri ayaan ku arki doonaa), 또 만나요 (mar kale ayaan ku arki doonaa) iyo 잘 자요 (hurdo wanaagsan).
korean-k2-l6.example: 잘 가요. (jal gayo.) = Nabadgelyo. (saaxiibtinimo) / 내일 봐요. (naeil bwayo.) = Berri ayaan ku arki doonaa.

korean-k2-l7.title: Sideed tahay?
korean-k2-l7.concept: Weydii 잘 지냈어요? (Ma fiicnayd?) oo ku jawaab 잘 지내요 (Waan fiicanahay). 좋은 아침이에요 macnaheedu waa “Waa subax wanaagsan.”

korean-k2-l8.title: Weydiisashada caawimaad
korean-k2-l8.concept: Dheh 도와주세요 si aad caawimaad u weydiisato, 모르겠어요 marka aanad aqoon, 알겠어요 marka aad fahantay, iyo 다시 말해 주세요 si aad qof ugu codsato inuu mar kale yiraahdo.
korean-k2-l8.example: 도와주세요. (dowajuseyo.) = Fadlan i caawi. / 알겠어요. (algesseoyo.) = Waan fahmay.

korean-k2-l9.title: Jeceylka iyo jawaabaha
korean-k2-l9.concept: 좋아요 macnaheedu waa fiican ama ku habboon, 싫어요 macnaheedu waa ma jeclid, 맞아요 macnaheedu waa “sax”, 틀려요 macnaheedu waa “khalad”.
korean-k2-l9.example: 좋아요. (joayo.) = Waa fiican. / 싫어요. (sireoyo.) = Ma jeclahay.

korean-k3-l1.title: Arday ayaan ahay
korean-k3-l1.concept: **저는** macnaheedu waa “aniga” (edeb). Dhig **이에요** shibbane ka dib iyo **예요** shaqal ka dib si aad u tidhaahdo “Waxaan ahay …”.
korean-k3-l1.example: 저는 학생이에요. (jeoneun haksaengieyo.) = Arday ayaan ahay.

korean-k3-l10.title: Farriin u dirista saaxiib
korean-k3-l10.concept: Farriimaha qoran waxay isticmaalaan weedho gaagaaban oo edeb leh oo ku dhammaada **-요**. **지금 어디예요?** waxay weydiisaa halka aad joogto, **곧 가요** macnaheedu waa “dhawaan ayaan imaanayaa” iyo **늦어요** macnaheedu waa “waan raagay”.
korean-k3-l10.example: 지금 어디예요? (jigeum eodiyeyo?) = Xaggaad joogtaa hadda? / 곧 가요. (got gayo.) = Dhawaan ayaan imaanayaa.

korean-k3-l11.title: Erayada si dhawaaqa loo akhriyo
korean-k3-l11.concept: Marka dhawaaqa dhammaadkiisu yahay shibbane oo kan xiga uu ku bilowdo shaqal, codku wuu u dhaqaaqaa: 책이 waxaa loo akhriyaa **chaegi** iyo 밥을 waxaa loo akhriyaa **babeul**. Codad qaar ayaa sidoo kale beddela kuwa ku xiga: 국물 waxaa loo akhriyaa **gungmul** iyo 같이 waxaa loo akhriyaa **gachi**.

korean-k3-l2.title: Qoyskayga
korean-k3-l2.concept: Erayada qoyska waxaa si badan loogu isticmaalaa Kuuriyaanka, xataa dadka aan qoys ahayn.

korean-k3-l3.title: Tirinta
korean-k3-l3.concept: Kuuriyaanku wuxuu leeyahay laba nidaam oo tirooyin ah: kuwa asalka Kuuriyaanka ah (하나, 둘, 셋 …) oo loo isticmaalo tirinta wax, iyo kuwa Sino-Kuuriyaanka ah (일, 이, 삼 …) oo loo isticmaalo lacag, taariikh iyo daqiiqado.

korean-k3-l4.title: Tirooyinka asalka ah 6–10
korean-k3-l4.concept: Sii wad tirooyinka asalka ah ee Kuuriyaanka: 여섯 (6), 일곱 (7), 여덟 (8), 아홉 (9), 열 (10).
korean-k3-l4.example: 여섯 · 일곱 · 여덟 · 아홉 · 열 (yeoseot · ilgop · yeodeol · ahop · yeol)

korean-k3-l5.title: Tirooyinka Sino-Kuuriyaanka
korean-k3-l5.concept: Tirooyinka Sino-Kuuriyaanka: 일 (1), 이 (2), 삼 (3), 사 (4), 오 (5), 육 (6), 칠 (7), 팔 (8), 구 (9), 십 (10). Waxaa loo isticmaalaa lacag, taariikh, lambarrada taleefanka iyo daqiiqado.
korean-k3-l5.example: 일 · 이 · 삼 · 사 · 오 · 육 · 칠 · 팔 · 구 · 십 (il · i · sam · sa · o · yuk · chil · pal · gu · sip)

korean-k3-l6.title: Da'da
korean-k3-l6.concept: Weydii 몇 살이에요? (Intaad jirtaa?). Da'da waxaa lagu sheegaa tirooyinka asalka ah iyo 살: 열 살 (10 jir), 스무 살 (20), 서른 살 (30).

korean-k3-l8.title: Erayo kale oo qoys
korean-k3-l8.concept: Walaalaha waxay isticmaalaan erayo kala duwan iyadoo loo eegayo cidda hadlaysa: haweeney ayaa tiraahda 오빠 (walaal weyn oo wiil ah) iyo 언니 (walaal weyn oo gabar ah). Sidoo kale 아들 (wiil), 딸 (gabar), 부모님 (waalidiin).
korean-k3-l8.example: 오빠 (oppa) = walaal weyn oo wiil ah (haweeney ayaa leh) / 언니 (eonni) = walaal weyn oo gabar ah (haweeney ayaa leh)

korean-k3-l9.title: Qoyskeenna
korean-k3-l9.concept: Kuuriyaanku inta badan waxay dhahaan 우리 (annaga, our) halkii ay ka dhihi lahaayeen “my”: 우리 가족 waxay ka dhigan tahay “qoyskayga”. Dadka ku tiri 명: 네 명 (afar qof).

korean-k4-l1.title: Falalka maalinlaha ah
korean-k4-l1.concept: Falalka xilliga hadda ee edebta leh waxay ku dhammaadaan **-아요 / -어요 / -해요**. Qaabka isku mid ah ayaa loo isticmaalaa “aniga”, “adiga” iyo “iyaga”.

korean-k4-l2.title: Tegidda meelaha
korean-k4-l2.concept: Meesha dabadeed dheh **에** si aad u sheegto meesha aad tagto ama ka timaaddo: 학교에 가요. Falku wuxuu yimaadaa ugu dambeyn.
korean-k4-l2.example: 학교에 가요. (hakgyoe gayo.) = Waxaan aadaa dugsiga.

korean-k4-l3.title: Cunista, cabbidda, akhriska
korean-k4-l3.concept: Ujeeddada falka waxaa lagu daraa **을** shibbane ka dib iyo **를** shaqal ka dib: 밥을 먹어요, 커피를 마셔요.
korean-k4-l3.example: 밥을 먹어요. (babeul meogeoyo.) = Waxaan cunaa cunto.

korean-k4-l4.title: Cunto iyo cabitaan
korean-k4-l4.concept: 밥 (bariis, cunto), 빵 (rooti), 과일 (miro), 고기 (hilib), 물 (biyo), 우유 (caano).

korean-k4-l5.title: Jeceylka iyo nacaybka
korean-k4-l5.concept: Ku sheeg waxa aad jeceshahay adigoo isticmaalaya -를/을 좋아해요 iyo waxa aanad jeclayn adigoo isticmaalaya -를/을 싫어해요: 저는 사과를 좋아해요.

korean-k4-l6.title: Sharaxaadda waxyaabaha
korean-k4-l6.concept: Erayada sharraxaadda sidoo kale waxay ku dhammaadaan -요: 커요 (weyn), 작아요 (yar), 많아요 (badan), 맛있어요 (macaan), 예뻐요 (quruxsan).
korean-k4-l6.example: 커요. (keoyo.) = Waa weyn yahay. / 작아요. (jagayo.) = Waa yar yahay.

korean-k4-l7.title: Cimilada
korean-k4-l7.concept: 날씨 (cimilo), 더워요 (waa kulayl), 추워요 (waa qabow), 비가 와요 (roob ayaa da'ayo), 눈이 와요 (barafku wuu da'ayaa).
korean-k4-l7.example: 더워요. (deowoyo.) = Waa kulayl. / 추워요. (chuwoyo.) = Waa qabow.

korean-k4-l8.title: Diidmada 안 iyo 못
korean-k4-l8.concept: Dhig **안** fal ka hor si aad u tidhaahdo ma sameyso wax (안 가요). Dhig **못** ka hor si aad u tidhaahdo ma awooddo (못 가요).

korean-k4-l9.title: Hawlaha maalinlaha ah
korean-k4-l9.concept: 일어나요 (toos), 씻어요 (dhaq), 일해요 (shaqee), 자요 (seexo). Erayada waqtiga sida 아침 (subax) iyo 밤 (habeen) waxay qaataan 에: 아침에.

korean-k5-l1.title: Shalay, maanta, berri
korean-k5-l1.concept: Erayada waqtiga inta badan waxay yimaadaan meel u dhow bilowga weedhda.

korean-k5-l2.title: Waxa aan sameeyay
korean-k5-l2.concept: Waqtiga la soo dhaafay: **-았어요 / -었어요 / -했어요**. Falal qaar way gaabtaan: 가다 → 갔어요, 보다 → 봤어요.

korean-k5-l3.title: Waxa aan sameyn doono
korean-k5-l3.concept: Isticmaal **-(으)ㄹ 거예요** qorshayaasha: 가다 → 갈 거예요, 먹다 → 먹을 거예요.
korean-k5-l3.example: 내일 갈 거예요. (naeil gal geoyeyo.) = Berri ayaan tegi doonaa.

korean-k5-l4.title: Maalmaha toddobaadka
korean-k5-l4.concept: 월요일 (Isn), 화요일 (Tal), 수요일 (Arb), 목요일 (Kha), 금요일 (Jim), 토요일 (Sab), 일요일 (Axd).

korean-k5-l5.title: Bilaha
korean-k5-l5.concept: Bilaha waa lambar Sino-Kuuriyaan ah oo lagu daray 월: 일월 (Janaayo), 삼월 (Maarso), 오월 (Maajo), 칠월 (Luulyo), 구월 (Sebtembar), 십이월 (Diseembar).

korean-k5-l6.title: Sheegidda saacadda
korean-k5-l6.concept: Saacadaha waxay isticmaalaan tirooyin asal ah oo lagu daray 시: 한 시 (1:00), 두 시 (2:00), 세 시 (3:00), 열 시 (10:00). Weydii 몇 시예요?
korean-k5-l6.example: 한 시 · 두 시 · 세 시 (han si · du si · se si)

korean-k5-l7.title: Inta jeer
korean-k5-l7.concept: 매일 (maalin kasta), 자주 (inta badan), 가끔 (mararka qaarkood), 항상 (mar walba). Dhig falka ka hor.
korean-k5-l7.example: 매일 (maeil) = maalin kasta / 가끔 (gakkeum) = mararka qaarkood

korean-k5-l8.title: Waqtiga la soo dhaafay oo dheeraad ah
korean-k5-l8.concept: Dhammaadka waqtiga la soo dhaafay waa -았/었어요: 했어요 (sameeyay), 왔어요 (yimid), 만났어요 (la kulmay), 샀어요 (iibsaday), 잤어요 (seexday).

korean-k5-l9.title: Dhalashada iyo dhammaadka toddobaadka
korean-k5-l9.concept: 생일 (dhalasho), 주말 (dhammaadka toddobaadka), 선물 (hadiyad). Weydii 생일이 언제예요? oo ku jawaab 제 생일은 오월이에요.
korean-k5-l9.example: 생일이 언제예요? (saengiri eonjeyeyo?) = Goorma ayaa dhalashadaadu tahay?

korean-k6-l1.title: Dukaanka
korean-k6-l1.concept: Weydii qiimaha adigoo isticmaalaya 얼마예요? oo weydiiso wax adigoo isticmaalaya **… 주세요** (… fadlan).

korean-k6-l2.title: Xaggee yaal?
korean-k6-l2.concept: Weydii **… 어디예요?** (Xaggee yaal …?). Dhegayso 오른쪽 (midig), 왼쪽 (bidix) iyo 직진 (toos).
korean-k6-l2.example: 화장실이 어디예요? (hwajangsiri eodiyeyo?) = Xaggee yaal musqushu?

korean-k6-l3.title: Waxaan rabaa inaan …
korean-k6-l3.concept: Ku dar **-고 싶어요** xididka fal si aad u tidhaahdo waxa aad rabto inaad sameyso: 가다 → 가고 싶어요.
korean-k6-l3.example: 가고 싶어요. (gago sipeoyo.) = Waxaan rabaa inaan tago.

korean-k6-l4.title: Makhaayadda
korean-k6-l4.concept: 메뉴 (liiska cuntada), 주문할게요 (waan dalbanayaa), 물 더 주세요 (biyo dheeraad ah, fadlan), 계산해 주세요 (xisaabta, fadlan).

korean-k6-l5.title: Meel ka meel u socodka
korean-k6-l5.concept: 버스 (bas), 지하철 (tareen dhulka hoostiisa), 택시 (taksi), 기차 (tareen). Sheeg sida aad u tagto adigoo isticmaalaya -로/으로: 버스로 가요.
korean-k6-l5.example: 버스 (beoseu) = bas / 지하철 (jihacheol) = tareen dhulka hoostiisa

korean-k6-l6.title: Wicitaannada iyo farriimaha
korean-k6-l6.concept: 전화 (wicitaan taleefan), 전화번호 (lambarka taleefanka), 문자 (farriin qoran). 전화해요 macnaheedu waa “waan wacayaa”.

korean-k6-l7.title: Isbitaalka
korean-k6-l7.concept: 병원 (isbitaal), 약 (daawo), 아파요 (way xanuunaysaa). Marka hore sheeg qaybta jidhka: 머리가 아파요 (madaxaygu wuu xanuunayaa).

korean-k6-l8.title: Codsiyo edeb leh
korean-k6-l8.concept: -세요 iyo -아/어 주세요 waxay sameeyaan codsiyo edeb leh: 앉으세요 (fadlan fadhiiso), 기다려 주세요 (fadlan sug), 문을 열어 주세요 (fadlan albaabka fur).

korean-k6-l9.title: Si wadajir ah u qorshaynta
korean-k6-l9.concept: 같이 (wada jir) waxay qof ku martiqaadaysaa: 같이 가요. 갈래요? waxay weydiisaa “Ma doonaysaa inaad tagto?” 시간 있어요? na waxay weydiisaa “Ma waqti leedahay?”
korean-k6-l9.example: 같이 가요. (gachi gayo.) = Aan wada aadno.

korean-k7-l1.title: Dhammaadyo edeb leh oo rasmi ah
korean-k7-l1.concept: Hadalka rasmiga ah iyo shaqada, ku dar -ㅂ니다  xididka falka ama tilmaamaha ku dhammaada shaqal, iyo -습니다 xididka ku dhammaada shibbane. Su'aalaha waxay ku dhammaadaan -ㅂ니까 / -습니까.
korean-k7-l1.example: 저는 학생입니다. (jeoneun haksaengimnida.) = Waxaan ahay arday. / 이름이 무엇입니까? (ireumi mueosimnikka?) = Magacaagu waa maxay?

korean-k7-l10.title: Isu-dhigma iyo waxa aan laga baxsanayn (-을수록, -기 마련이다)
korean-k7-l10.concept: Marka... ay ka sii badato (-을수록) iyo dabiici ahaan waa lagama-maarmaan (-기 마련이다).
korean-k7-l10.example: 만날수록 좋아요. (mannalsurok joayo.) = marka aan isku nimaadno ayuu sii fiicnaadaa / 사람은 실수하기 마련이에요. (sarameun silsuhagi maryeonieyo.) = qofku khalad ayuu sameeyaa

korean-k7-l11.title: Muuqaal iyo ka-soo-gaabin (-아/어 보이다, -는 모양이다)
korean-k7-l11.concept: Waxay u muuqataa (-아/어 보이다) iyo waxay u egtahay (-는 모양이다).
korean-k7-l11.example: 행복해 보여요. (haengbokae boyeoyo.) = farxad ayuu u muuqdaa / 비가 오는 모양이에요. (biga oneun moyangieyo.) = roob ayaa u egyahay inuu da'ayo

korean-k7-l12.title: Iska-yeel (-는 척하다)
korean-k7-l12.concept: Iska yeel inaad wax samaynayso ama tahay: -(으)ㄴ/는 척하다.
korean-k7-l12.example: 아는 척해요. (aneun cheokaeyo.) = iska yeel inuu og yahay

korean-k7-l13.title: Qoomamo iyo xaalado ka duwan runta (-(으)ㄹ 걸 그랬어요)
korean-k7-l13.concept: Muujinta qoomamada: 'Waxaan lahaa inaan sameeyo...' -(으)ㄹ 걸 그랬어요.
korean-k7-l13.example: 일찍 올 걸 그랬어요. (iljjik ol geol geuraesseoyo.) = waxay ahayd in goor hore la yimaado

korean-k7-l14.title: Dib-u-eegis dhammaystiran ee K7
korean-k7-l14.concept: Dib u eeg hadalka aan tooska ahayn, xirayaasha adag iyo odhaahyada khafiifka ah.
korean-k7-l14.example: 친구가 온다고 했어요. (chinguga ondago haesseoyo.) = saaxiib ayaa yidhi wuu imanayaa / 같이 밥 먹자고 했어요. (gachi bap meokjago haesseoyo.) = ayaa soo jeediyay in wada cunno

korean-k7-l2.title: Qaababka caadiga ah
korean-k7-l2.concept: Qaabka caadiga ah (ee qoraalka) wuxuu dhammaystiraa weedhaha caadiga ah -ㄴ다 / -는다 iyo kuwa waqtigii hore -았다 / -었다. Qaababkani waa aasaaska hadalka la soo xigtay ee casharrada soo socda.
korean-k7-l2.example: 나는 학교에 간다. (naneun hakgyoe ganda.) = Waxaan aadaa dugsiga. / 동생은 책을 읽는다. (dongsaengeun chaegeul ingneunda.) = Walaalkay yar buug ayaa akhriya.

korean-k7-l3.title: Qeexidda magacyada
korean-k7-l3.concept: Fal ama tilmaame ayaa qeexi kara magac: -(으)ㄴ tilmaamayaasha iyo falalka waqtigii hore, -는 falalka hadda, -(으)ㄹ falalka mustaqbalka ama la qorsheeyay, waxaana la dhigaa magaca ka hor.
korean-k7-l3.example: 저는 맛있는 음식을 좋아해요. (jeoneun masinneun eumsigeul joahaeyo.) = Waan jeclahay cunto macaan. / 예쁜 꽃을 샀어요. (yeppeun kkocheul sasseoyo.) = Ubaxyo quruxsan ayaan iibsaday.

korean-k7-l4.title: Xiriiriyeyaasha aasaasiga ah
korean-k7-l4.concept: Laba qaybood ku xir -아/어서 (sabab ama isku xigid), -지만 (kala duwanaansho), -(으)니까 (sabab), -(으)면 (haddii) iyo -(으)려고 (si loo).
korean-k7-l4.example: 피곤해서 일찍 잤어요. (pigonhaeseo iljjik jasseoyo.) = Waan daalnaa, sidaa darteed waan hurday goor hore. / 비가 와서 집에 있었어요. (biga waseo jibe isseosseoyo.) = Roob ayaa da'ay, sidaa darteed guriga ayaan joogay.

korean-k7-l5.title: Awood, waajibaad, oggolaansho
korean-k7-l5.concept: -(으)ㄹ 수 있다/없다 waxay muujisaa awood ama suurtagal, -아/어야 하다 waajibaad, iyo -아/어도 되다 oggolaansho.
korean-k7-l5.example: 저는 수영할 수 있어요. (jeoneun suyeonghal su isseoyo.) = Waan dabaalan karaa. / 저는 한국어로 이야기할 수 있어요. (jeoneun hangugeoro iyagihal su isseoyo.) = Kuuriyaan ayaan ku hadli karaa.

korean-k7-l6.title: Hadal aan toos ahayn (-다고 하다)
korean-k7-l6.concept: Soo sheeg wixii qof yidhaahdo ama yidhi: fal/tilmaame + -다고 하다.
korean-k7-l6.example: 친구가 온다고 해요. (chinguga ondago haeyo.) = saaxiib ayaa yidhi wuu imanayaa

korean-k7-l7.title: Su'aalo aan toos ahayn (-냐고 하다)
korean-k7-l7.example: 어디 가냐고 물었어요. (eodi ganyago mureosseoyo.) = waxaa la weydiiyay xaggee loo socdo

korean-k7-l8.title: Amar iyo soo jeedin aan toos ahayn (-라고 / -자고 하다)
korean-k7-l8.concept: Soo sheeg amar (-라고 하다) ama soo jeedin (-자고 하다).
korean-k7-l8.example: 빨리 오라고 했어요. (ppalli orago haesseoyo.) = waxaa la yidhi dhaqso u kaalay / 같이 가자고 했어요. (gachi gajago haesseoyo.) = waxaa la soo jeediyay in la wada tago

korean-k7-l9.title: Sababo iyo is-diidmo adag (-느라고, -는데도)
korean-k7-l9.concept: Sabab xun ama dib-u-dhac (-느라고) iyo is-diidmo xaaladaha ka soo horjeeda (-는데도).
korean-k7-l9.example: 공부하느라고 바빴어요. (gongbuhaneurago bapasseoyo.) = mashquul ku ahaa waxbarasho / 비가 오는데도 갔어요. (biga oneundedo gasseoyo.) = inkastoo roob jiray ayaa la tegay

korean-k8-l1.title: Erayada maamuuska ee mawduucyada
korean-k8-l1.concept: Magacyo iyo falal maamuus gaar ah oo loogu talagalay dad la ixtiraamo: 진지, 주무시다, 편찮으시다.
korean-k8-l1.example: 할머니께서 진지를 드세요. (halmeonikkeseo jinjireul deuseyo.) = ayeeyo cuntada way cunaysaa

korean-k8-l2.title: Falalka maamuuska ee shayga (드리다, 뵙다, 여쭙다)
korean-k8-l2.concept: Falal is-hoosaysiin/maamuus marka ficilku loo jeedo qof ka weyn: 드리다, 뵙다, 여쭙다.
korean-k8-l2.example: 선물을 드려요. (seonmureul deuryeoyo.) = hadiyad la siiyo (maamuus) / 내일 봬요. (naeil bwaeyo.) = berri la arko (maamuus)

korean-k8-l3.title: Falalka aan firfircoonayn ee qaybta (-이/히/리/기-)
korean-k8-l3.concept: Falal aan firfircoonayn oo lagu sameeyo ku darista -이/히/리/기-: 보이다, 들리다, 열리다, 닫히다.
korean-k8-l3.example: 문이 열려요. (muni yeollyeoyo.) = albaabku wuu furmaa / 창문이 닫혀요. (changmuni dachyeoyo.) = daaqaddu way xirmaysaa

korean-k8-l4.title: Falalka aan firfircoonayn ee isku-xirka (-어지다, -게 되다)
korean-k8-l4.concept: Falal qaata qaabab aan firfircoonayn oo si iskiis ah ama natiijo ah: -아/어지다, -게 되다.
korean-k8-l4.example: 글씨가 써져요. (geulssiga sseojyeoyo.) = far si wanaagsan loo qoray / 알게 되었어요. (alge doeeosseoyo.) = ogaaday

korean-k8-l5.title: Sababeynta qaybta (-이/히/리/기/우-)
korean-k8-l5.concept: Falal sababeyn ah oo qof ka dhigaya inuu ficil sameeyo: 보여 주다, 먹이다, 입히다.
korean-k8-l5.example: 사진을 보여 줘요. (sajineul boyeo jwoyo.) = sawirka ayaa la tusaa / 아기에게 밥을 먹여요. (agiege babeul meogyeoyo.) = ilmaha ayaa la quudiyaa

korean-k8-l6.title: Sababeynta isku-xirka (-게 하다)
korean-k8-l6.concept: In qof lagu sameeyo ama laga dhigo inuu wax sameeyo: -게 하다.
korean-k8-l6.example: 웃게 해요. (utge haeyo.) = qosol ka dhig / 기다리게 했어요. (gidarige haesseoyo.) = la sugay

korean-k8-l7.title: Hab rasmi ah oo dadweyne (-하십시오)
korean-k8-l7.concept: Hab rasmi ah oo aad u sarreeya oo loogu talagalay ogeysiisyo iyo dabaaldegyo: -하십시오, -하십시다.
korean-k8-l7.example: 자리에 앉으십시오. (jarie anjeusipsio.) = fadlan fadhiiso / 출발하십시다. (chulbalhasipsida.) = aan bixno

korean-k8-l8.title: Hadallo is-hoosaysiin iyo hoos-u-dhigis
korean-k8-l8.concept: Hadal edeb leh oo isticmaalaya magac-bedelayaal iyo falal is-hoosaysiin ah: 저희, 말씀 올리다.
korean-k8-l8.example: 인사 말씀 올립니다. (insa malsseum ollimnida.) = hadallo salaan la bixiyo / 저희 학교입니다. (jeohui hakgyoimnida.) = iskuulkeenna (is-hoosaysiin)

korean-k8-l9.title: Dib u eegis Guud K8
korean-k8-l9.concept: Dib u eeg xushmadda, falka la dhigay (passive), falka sababaynta (causative) iyo hab-qoraalka xushmadda rasmiga ah.
korean-k8-l9.example: 할머니께 선물을 드렸어요. (halmeonikke seonmureul deuryeosseoyo.) = hadiyad ayaa la siiyay ayeeyada / 문이 저절로 닫혔어요. (muni jeojeollo dachyeosseoyo.) = albaabku isagu wuu xidhmay

korean-k9-l1.title: Qorista iimaylka ganacsiga iyo codsiyada
korean-k9-l1.concept: Caadooyinka iimaylka ganacsiga ee rasmiga ah: -에 관하여, 검토 부탁드립니다.
korean-k9-l1.example: 회의 안건에 관하여 말씀드립니다. (hoeui angeone gwanhayeo malsseumdeurimnida.) = ku saabsan ajandaha kulanka

korean-k9-l2.title: Edebta telefoonka ganacsiga
korean-k9-l2.concept: Maaraynta wicitaannada iyo farriimaha: 통화 가능하신지요, 연결해 드리겠습니다.
korean-k9-l2.example: 지금 통화 가능하신지요? (jigeum tonghwa ganeunghasinjiyo?) = hadda la hadli karaa / 담당자를 연결해 드리겠습니다. (damdangjareul yeongyeolhae deurigetseumnida.) = qofka mas'uulka ah ayaa la xiraya

korean-k9-l3.title: Qorshaynta iyo dib u qorshaynta
korean-k9-l3.concept: Soo jeedinta iyo beddelka waqtiyada ballamaha: 변경하고자 합니다, 양해 부탁드립니다.
korean-k9-l3.example: 일정을 변경하고자 합니다. (iljeongeul byeongyeonghagoja hamnida.) = codsi beddelka jadwalka / 너른 양해 부탁드립니다. (neoreun yanghae butakdeurimnida.) = waxaan weydiisanayaa fahamkaaga wanaagsan

korean-k9-l4.title: Wadahadallada kulamada iyo aragtiyaha
korean-k9-l4.concept: Muujinta aragtida inta lagu jiro kulamada: 제 생각으로는, 찬성합니다, 추가 검토.
korean-k9-l4.example: 제 생각으로는 이번 안이 좋습니다. (je saenggakeoroneun ibeon ani jotseumnida.) = aragtidayda, soo jeedintan way wanaagsan tahay / 적극 찬성합니다. (jeokgeuk chanseonghamnida.) = aad ayaan ula jiraa

korean-k9-l5.title: Soo sheegidda horumarka mashruuca
korean-k9-l5.concept: Bixinta warbixinta xaaladda: 진행 상황을 보고합니다, 조치를 완료했습니다.
korean-k9-l5.example: 프로젝트 진행 상황을 보고합니다. (peurojekteu jinhaeng sanghwangeul bogohamnida.) = horumarka mashruuca ayaa la soo sheegayaa / 조치를 완료했습니다. (jochireul wallyohaesseumnida.) = tallaabada waa la dhammaystiray

korean-k9-l6.title: Tirooyinka tirakoobka iyo isbeddelada xogta
korean-k9-l6.concept: Sharaxaadda isbeddelada iyo tirooyinka: 증가했습니다, 전년 대비.
korean-k9-l6.example: 매출이 증가했습니다. (maechuri jeunggahaesseumnida.) = iibku wuu kordhay / 전년 대비 상승했습니다. (jeonnyeon daebi sangseunghaesseumnida.) = wuu kordhay marka loo barbardhigo sannadkii hore

korean-k9-l7.title: Wada-xaajoodyada ganacsiga iyo wada-shaqeynta
korean-k9-l7.concept: Iskaashiga xirfadeed: 상호 협력을 희망합니다, 절충안 제시.
korean-k9-l7.example: 상호 협력을 희망합니다. (sangho hyeomnyeogeul huimanghamnida.) = waxaan rajeynaa iskaashi is-weydaarsi ah / 절충안을 제안합니다. (jeolchuganeul jeanhamnida.) = waxaan soo jeedinayaa heshiis dhex-dhexaad ah

korean-k9-l8.title: Kaarka ganacsiga iyo magacyada xirfadeed
korean-k9-l8.concept: Is-dhaafsiga kaararka iyo magacyada: 처음 뵙겠습니다, 명함 드립니다.

texts.g:baf61f2b: Fasalkeenna waxaa ku jira toban arday.
texts.g:74473c7a: Gurigeenna waxaa ku jira toddoba kursi.
texts.n:k.k3.numbers:nat: Tirooyinka asalka ah ee Kuuriya waxay tiriyaan waxyaabaha iyo dadka; kow, labo, saddex iyo afar waxay beddelaan qaab ka hor tiriyaha.
texts.n:k.k3.numbers:sinoN: Tirooyinka Sino-Kuuriya waxaa loo isticmaalaa dabaqyada, bilaha, tirooyinka waddooyinka iyo xisaabta.
texts.n:k.k3.numbers:ctr: Eray tiriye kasta (koobab, buugaag, xayawaan, dhalooyin, dad) waxaa la dhigaa tirada iyo magaca ka dib.
texts.n:k.k3.numbers:mathN: Xisaabta, waxaa la isticmaalaa tirooyinka Sino-Kuuriya, jawaabtana waxaa raacda ficilka isku-xirka.
texts.g:e5d694e4: Hal dhalo oo biyo ah, fadlan.
texts.g:34e20af8: Afar laga jaray kow waa saddex.
texts.g:30314885: kow ilaa shan (iyadoo la isticmaalayo tirooyinka asalka ah ee Kuuriya)
texts.n:k.k3.ourfamily:ourK: Kuuriyaanku inta badan waxay yidhaahdaan 'keenna' meesha Ingiriisigu yidhaahdo 'kayga', gaar ahaan xubnaha qoyska, guriga iyo iskuulka.
texts.n:k.k3.ourfamily:famN: Si loo sheego tirada xubnaha qoyska, tiro asal ah waxay ka horraysaa tiriyaha dadka.
texts.n:k.k3.ourfamily:birth: Erayada kala-horreynta dhalashada waxay muujiyaan meesha qof ka galo carruurta qoyska dhexdooda.
texts.n:k.k3.ourfamily:ask: Erayga su'aasha micnaheedu yahay 'imisa' wuxuu yimaadaa ka hor tiriyaha dadka.
texts.g:75e42a3f: Waxaan nahay qoys shan qof ah.
texts.g:fdcf615c: Waxaan nahay qoys saddex qof ah.
texts.g:3f1396d9: Waa aabbahay, hooyaday, walaalkay weyn, iyo aniga.
texts.g:6d201884: Guriga waxaa ku jira hal bisad.
texts.g:4e4947cd: Qof kasta oo qoyskayga ah waa Kuuriyaan.
texts.g:69de8d0f: Imisa qof ayaa ku jira qoyskaaga?
texts.n:k.k3.people:dem: Erayga tilmaamaha ee ka horreeya magac wuxuu tilmaamaa qof ama shay ka fog labada hadlaya.
texts.n:k.k3.people:cnt: Si loo tiriyo dadka, lambar asal ah ayaa yimaada ka hor tiriyaha dadka.
texts.n:k.k3.people:occ: Magacyada shaqooyinka waa magacyo, sidaa darteed waxay qaataan copula si loo yiraahdo waxa qof qabto.
texts.n:k.k3.self:copula: Si loo yiraahdo 'Waxaan ahay ...', magacu waxaa raaca copula oo qaabkeedu ku xidhan yahay in magacu ku dhammaado shaqal ama shibbane.
texts.n:k.k3.self:negCop: Si loo yiraahdo 'ma aha', magacu wuxuu qaataa tilmaamaha mowduuca waxaana raaca copula diidmo gaar ah.
texts.n:k.k3.self:alsoP: Tilmaamaha micnaheedu yahay 'sidoo kale' wuxuu bedelaa tilmaamaha mowduuca.
texts.n:k.k3.self:natQ: Erayada su'aasha sida 'maxay', 'yaa' iyo 'kee' waxay bedelaan qaybta aan la aqoon ee weedhda; nidaamka erayadu waa isla sidiisii.
texts.s:c790431f: Hadda ayaa laguu soo bandhigay qof markii ugu horreysay, waxaadna rabtaa inaad sheegto inaad ku farxday kulankaas.
texts.n:k.k3.sino:money: Qiimaha waxaa lagu sheegaa lambar Sino-Kuuriyaan ah oo ay raacdo erayga lacagta; toban kun waa cutub u gaar ah oo ka sarreeya kumanyaal.
texts.n:k.k3.sino:irrMonth: Magacyada laba bilood waxay beddelaan higgaadda: labadooda, lambarku wuxuu ka tuuraa shibbanihiisa dambe ka hor erayga bisha.
texts.n:k.k3.sino:mathS: Xisaabta iyo lambarrada telefoonka waxaa lagu akhriyaa lambarro Sino-Kuuriyaan ah, jawaabtana waxaa raacda copula.
texts.n:k.k3.sino:dateS: Taariikhaha waxaa lagu yidhaa bisha, kadibna maalinta, iyadoo la isticmaalayo lambarro Sino-Kuuriyaan ah oo leh cutubyada bisha iyo maalinta.
texts.n:k.k3.sino:bigN: Lambarrada waaweyn ee Sino-Kuuriyaan waxaa laga dhisaa tobanaan, boqolaal iyo kumanyaal oo bidix ilaa midig la akhriyo.
texts.g:ace273d9: Lambarka telefoonkayga waa eber-hal-eber, laba-saddex-afar-shan, lix-todobo-sideed-sagaal.
texts.n:k.k3.sounds:linkC: Shibbane dambe ayaa u gudbaa dhawaaqa xiga marka dhawaaqaas ku bilaabmo xaraf shibbane aamusan, sidaas darteed waxay u egtahay mid isku xiran.
texts.n:k.k3.sounds:doubleC: Laba shibbane dambe ah, kaliya mid ayaa la dhawaaqaa ka hor shibbane, laakiin ka hor shaqal, kan labaad wuxuu ku xirmaa dhawaaqa xiga.
texts.n:k.k3.sounds:hDrop: Codka h waa aamusan yahay ka dib shaqal ama n, m, l, ng; codadka ku dhow ka dib ayay si siman isugu xirmaan.
texts.n:k.k3.sounds:nasal: Codka p, t ama k wuxuu noqdaa m, n ama ng marka shibbane sanka ah uu raaco.
texts.n:k.k3.sounds:rToN: Codka l ka dib joojin ama ng waxaa loo dhawaaqaa n, joojinta ka hortana waxay noqon kartaa mid sanka ah.
texts.n:k.k4.adjectives:adjSubj: Tilmaame-erayadu waxay sifeeyaan mawduuca lagu calaamadiyay 이/가, dhammaadka xushmadda 요 ayaana weedhda xidha.
texts.g:f0289db0: Subaxdii waan toosaa. Waan qadeeyaa. Habeenkii waan seexdaa.
texts.n:k.k4.food:foodWords: Magacyada cuntada waxay la isticmaalaan 을/를 iyo 먹어요 (cun), magacyada cabitaanka waxay la isticmaalaan 을/를 iyo 마셔요 (cab).
texts.g:f63370f4: gimbap (bariis iyo hadhuudh badda oo la duubay)
texts.g:549c55a7:
A: Subaxdii maxaad cuntaa?
B: Rooti iyo ukun ayaan cunaa.
texts.n:k.k4.likes:likesVerb: 좋아해요 (jecel) iyo 싫어해요 (nacay) waxay wadaan waxa la jecel yahay iyadoo la isticmaalayo 을/를, ma aha 이/가.
texts.g:8021d59e: Walaalkay yar wuxuu jecel yahay eyda.
texts.g:ff64aa38: Walaalkay weyn wuxuu jecel yahay buugaagta.
texts.g:11519667:
A: Miyaad jeceshahay qaxwaha?
B: Maya, ma jecli qaxwaha. Waan jeclahay shaaha.
texts.g:f276f946: Ma jecli xagaaga. Aad buu u kulul yahay. Waan jeclahay jiilaalka.
texts.n:k.k4.negation:negAn: 안 ka hor fal ama tilmaame waxay macnaheedu yahay si fudud in aan la samayn ama aan la ahayn, sida diidmo caadi ah.
texts.n:k.k4.negation:negMot: 못 ka hor fal waxay macnaheedu yahay ma awoodo, inaan wax samayn karin, lamana isticmaalo tilmaamayaasha.
texts.g:509d6c11:
A: Miyaad cabtaa qaxwo?
B: Maya, qaxwo ma cabbo. Shaah ayaan cabbaa.
texts.g:c38124e4:
A: Miyaad dabaashaa?
B: Maya, ma awoodo. Laakiin waan jeclahay jimicsiga.
texts.g:c8492b20: Aad ayaan u hurdaysanaa ilaa aanan indhaha furan karin.
texts.s:2678af18: Marka la ii weydiiyo qorshahayga, waan ka jawaabaa.
texts.g:82e36852:
A: Ma wada tagi layna buur fuulida usbuucan?
B: Lugta ayaan ku dhaawacmay, sidaas darteed ma tegi karo buurta.
A: Markaas shineemo ka dhig?
B: Shineemo way fiicantahay. Laakiin filimada cabsida ma daawado.
texts.n:k.k4.objects:objEulReul: Tilmaamaha shayga waa 을 marka uu ka dambeeyo shibbane dambe, iyo 를 marka uu ka dambeeyo shaqal, waxayna si toos ah u raacdaa magaca helaya fal-ficilka.
texts.g:2dfbebc8:
A: Maxaad cunaysaa?
B: Rooti ayaan cunaa. Waxaan kale oo cabbaa caano.
texts.n:k.k4.places:placeE: Xarafka 에 wuxuu calaamadeeyaa meesha loo socdo ee 가요 iyo 와요, wuxuuna si toos ah ugu dhegaa magaca meesha.
texts.g:7c15e05a: Walaalkay ka yar ayaa timaadda gurigeenna.
texts.g:49624570:
A: Xaggee aad tagaysaa?
B: Waxaan aadayaa suuqa.
A: Waxaan aadayaa bangiga.
texts.n:k.k4.verbs:verbPolite: Ficillada hadda ee xushmadda leh waxay ku dhammaadaan 요 waxaana lagu isticmaalaa 을/를 wixii la saameynayo, iyada oo aan isbeddel ku imaan I, adiga ama iyaga.
texts.n:k.k4.weather:weatherSeason: Erayada cimilada waxay qaataan 이/가 sida mawduuca, xilliguna wuxuu qaataa 에 si uu u muujiyo xilligaas gudihiisa.
texts.g:0e4d52ce: Maanta way qabow tahay si fudud.
texts.g:f5125f48: Dayrta way qabow tahay si fudud.
texts.g:3c53ec1e:
A: Maanta cimiladu sidee tahay?
B: Roob ayaa da'aya. Oo waa qabow.
texts.n:k.k5.birthday:bdA: Da'da waxaa lagu tiriyaa tirooyinka asalka ah ee Kuuriya iyo tiriyaha sannadaha da'da; hal tiro asal ah ayaa isugu soo gaabata ka hor.
texts.n:k.k5.birthday:bdB: Salaamo go'an ayaa loo isticmaalaa dhalashada, hambalyada iyo bilowga usbuuc-dhammaadka.
texts.n:k.k5.birthday:bdC: Qaybta waqtigu waxay calaamadisaa marka dhacdo dhacdo; qaybta shayga waxay calaamadisaa waxa la bixiyay ama la sameeyay.
texts.s:7e95e7f1: Waa Jimce oo macallinkaaga ayaad nabad-gelyo ku dhahaysaa.
texts.g:20963c43: Saaxiibadayda ayaa hadiyado i siiyay maalinta dhalashadayda.
texts.g:4686b3b9: Usbuuc-dhammaadka ayaan xaflad dhalasho yeelan doonaa.
texts.g:3cd1c6ef: Usbuuc-dhammaadkii hore waxaan aaday xafladda dhalashada saaxiibkay.
texts.g:1b7f5622: Saaxiibkay ubaxyo ayaan hadiyad ugu siiyay.
texts.g:2772df66:
A: Goorma tahay dhalashadaadu?
B: Jimcaha soo socda.
A: Markaas aan wada casheyno!
texts.g:d0cf1a36:
A: Maxaad samaynaysaa usbuuc-dhammaadkan?
B: Waxaan aadayaa xafladda dhalashada saaxiib.
A: Hadiyad ma iibsatay?
B: Haa, ubaxyo ayaan iibsaday.
texts.g:ec5d3d6f: Waan ka xumaaday inaan daahay xafladda dhalashada saaxiibkay.
texts.g:107e1a4d: Minho, dhalasho wanaagsan! Sannadkan sidoo kale caafimaad iyo farxad.
texts.g:8ad5fa92: Maalinta dhalashadayda waxaan la aaday shineemo walaashay weyn.
texts.g:1806d0ca: Walaalkay yar dhalashadan wuxuu gaadhayaa toban sano.
texts.g:e29f5955: Waad martiqaadan tahay! Xafladda dhalashadayda waxaan ku qabanayaa gurigayga Sabtidan saacadda saddexda galabnimo. Cuntada anigaa diyaarin doona. Hadiyad looma baahna. Fadlan si fudud u soo kaalay. Waxaa soo diray: Mina
texts.g:a05885a1:
A: Salaasada soo socota waa dhalashada Jisu.
B: Runtii? Ma aqaanin. Hadiyad noocee ah ayaa fiican?
A: Jisu waxay jeceshahay buugaag. Sidaa darteed buug ayaan iibsan doonaa.
B: Fikrad fiican. Kaar ayaan qori doonaa.
texts.n:k.k5.clock:clA: Saacadaha waxay isticmaalaan tirooyinka asalka ah ee Kuuriya halka daqiiqadaha ay isticmaalaan tirooyinka Sino-Kuuriya.
texts.n:k.k5.clock:clB: Qaar ka mid ah tirooyinka asalka ah way beddelmaan qaab ka hor tiriyaha saacadaha.
texts.n:k.k5.clock:clC: Eray macnaheedu yahay 'badh' ayaa beddeli kara soddon daqiiqo.
texts.g:876bb22c:
A: Saacaddu waa imisa hadda?
B: Waa 2:50.
A: Casharku wuxuu bilaabmaa saacadda saddexda. Aan dhakhso!
texts.g:a32fff25:
A: Filimku saacaddee ayuu bilaabmaa?
B: Wuxuu bilaabmaa toddobo iyo badh.
A: Markaa aan kulano 6:30.
texts.n:k.k5.frequency:frA: Falgaabyada soo noqnoqoshada waxay hortaagan yihiin fal; qaar ka mid ah waa in lagu isticmaalo fal diidmo ah.
texts.n:k.k5.frequency:frB: Si aad u sheegto inta jeer ee muddo gudaheed, sheeg muddada iyo qayb-yare, ka dibna tirada iyo tiriyaha jeerarka.
texts.n:k.k5.frequency:frC: Ku darista qayb-yaraha ama horgalaha 'kasta' erayga waqtiga waxay ka dhigaysaa caado joogto ah.
texts.g:c0bc1eb6: Dhammaadka toddobaadka kasta waxaan la kulmaa saaxiib.
texts.g:727b6ec7: Maalintii laba jeer ayaan ilkaha nadiifiyaa.
texts.g:5e6869fd: Mar walba waxaan dugsiga u tagaa tareenka dhulka hoostiisa.
texts.g:40c9d975:
A: Ma inta badan ayaad jimicsataa?
B: Haa, toddobaadkii saddex jeer.
A: Jimicsi noocee ah ayaad sameysaa?
B: Badanaa waan dabaalan.
texts.g:56524e78:
A: Ma maalin kasta ayaad kaafi cabtaa?
B: Maya, mararka qaarkood ayaan cabbaa. Badanaa shaah ayaan cabbaa.
texts.g:edec3cc0: Qoyskeenu wuxuu booqdaa guriga ayeeyo bishii mar.
texts.g:10adc3a6: Filimkan horeba saddex jeer ayaan daawaday.
texts.g:11b4fad4: Hooyo, maalmahan subax kasta lixda ayaan toosaa oo jimicsadaa.
texts.g:67b1f830: Tareenka dhulka hoostiisa mararka qaarkood waxaan akhriyaa buug, laakiin badanaa waxaan dhegaystaa muusig.
texts.g:49d31c08: Waxaan weydiiyay ardayda fasalkeenna. Toban ka mid ah, lix ayaa maalin kasta barata Kuuriyaan. Saddex ayaa toddobaadkii laba jeer barata. Mid ayaa mararka qaarkood barata.
texts.g:e98ebc82:
A: Ma inta badan ayaad cuntaa cunto Kuuriyaan ah?
B: Maya, naadir ayaan cunaa. Laakiin dhammaadka toddobaadka kasta waxaan cunaa tteokbokki.
A: Anna waan jeclahay tteokbokki. Toddobaadka dhammaadkiisa soo socda ma wada cuneynaa?
texts.n:k.k5.months:moA: Magacyada bilaha waa tirooyin Sino-Kuuriyaan ah oo lagu daray erayga bisha; laba ka mid ah waxaa lagu qoraa shibbane dambe oo laga tagay.
texts.n:k.k5.months:moB: Taariikhdu waxay u akhrisan tahay bisha marka hore, kaddib maalinta, labada qaybood waxay isticmaalaan tirooyin Sino-Kuuriyaan ah.
texts.n:k.k5.months:moC: Erayada xilliyadu waxay qaataan qayb-yaraha waqtiga ee macnihiisu yahay 'gudaha', inta badan iyadoo lagu daro calaamadda mawduuca.
texts.g:14e73174: Juun roobku aad buu u da'aa.
texts.n:k.k5.past:pastA: Waqtiga la soo dhaafay waxaa lagu sameeyaa iyadoo dhammaad lagu daro xididka fal; shaqalka dhammaadku wuxuu ku xiran yahay shaqalka ugu dambeeya ee xididka, falalka 'samee' waxay isticmaalaan qaab gaar ah.
texts.n:k.k5.past:pastB: Tilmaamayaasha waxay qaataan isla dhammaadyada waqtiga la soo dhaafay sida falalka waxayna sharxaan sida wax u ahaayeen.
texts.g:4b6ce6c1: Toddobaadkii hore waxaan la tegay saaxiib wax iibsi.
texts.g:a708245c: Shalay subaxdii waan hore u toosay.
texts.g:205e8a69: Dhammaadka toddobaadka guriga ayaan ku nasday.
texts.g:f8537f1c: Filimkii shalay runtii wuu madadaalo badnaa.
texts.g:c60ae8ca: Toddobaadkii hore aad ayaan u mashquulsanaa.
texts.g:9cd212c0: Casharku shalay wuxuu dhammaaday saacadda koowaad.
texts.g:bab3b20d: Shalay casho ayaan la cunay qoyskayga.
texts.g:1673a728:
A: Shalay maxaad samaysay?
B: Waxaan la kulmay saaxiib. Waxaanan daawaday filim.
texts.g:ea765dea:
A: Dhammaadka toddobaadka maxaad samaysay?
B: Guriga ayaan ku nasday. Waxaanan akhriyay buug.
texts.g:751591f5: Shalay maktabadda waxaan ka amaahday saddex buug.
texts.g:1f54472c: Yuna, aad ayaad u mahadsan tahay shalay.
texts.g:82cb09ee: Sabtidii hore waxaan wada karinnay casho guriga saaxiib.
texts.g:40862514: Xalay goor dambe ayaan sameeyay shaqada guriga, sidaas darteed subaxdii waan daallanaa.
texts.g:bf51d517: Minji, waan ka xumahay inaanan ka soo qaybgalin kulankii shalay. Aroortii ayaan madax xanuun ku bilaabay. Dawo ayaan qaatay oo guriga ayaan ku nasanayay. Hadda waan fiicanahay.
texts.g:83bfe9ee:
A: Dhammaadka usbuuca xaggee aad aadday?
B: Badda ayaan aaday. Sawirro badan ayaan sidoo kale qaaday.
A: Cimilada sidee ahayd?
B: Wax yar ayay qabow ahayd, laakiin aad bay u wanaagsanayd.
texts.n:k.k5.past2:p2A: Hiddaha falka ku dhammaada shaqal ama shibbane gaar ah ayaa isbeddela ka hor dhammaadka waqtigii hore.
texts.n:k.k5.past2:p2B: Falka 'ahaanshaha' wuxuu leeyahay qaabab gaar ah oo waqtigii hore ah, kuwaas oo ku xiran haddii magacu ku dhammaado shibbane ama shaqal.
texts.n:k.k5.past2:p2C: Eray diidmo ah oo la dhigo ka hor falka wuxuu bixiyaa 'ma sameyn' ama 'ma awoodin', falkuna wuxuu qaadaa dhammaadka waqtigii hore.
texts.g:db413c55: Shalay fasalka waxaa ku jiray toban arday.
texts.g:cd5d0c71: Shalay ma aan awoodin inaan hawsha guriga sameeyo.
texts.g:cbda6131: Kimchi-gaas aad buu u basbaas badnaa.
texts.g:053ddce0: Saaxiibkay waxaan ku sugay xaruntii tareenka dhulka hoostiisa soddon daqiiqo.
texts.g:354e1f87: Imtixaankii shalay runtii aad buu u adkaa.
texts.g:b9fa8ec4: Walaashay weyn shalay xafiiska ayay ka shaqaysay.
texts.g:4eaf849a: Riwaayadda muusigga ayaan ku heesay hees.
texts.g:ef4b18a8:
A: Maxaad shalay dugsiga u imaan weyday?
B: Calooshaydu way xanuunsatay. Isbitaalka ayaan aaday.
texts.g:38d87c8c:
A: Dad badan ma joogeen xafladdii shalay?
B: Haa, aad bay u badnaayeen. Cuntadu sidoo kale way macaanayd.
texts.g:8c5854e8: Shalay qadada waxaan la cunay galbitang saaxiib, aadna aad bay u kulushay.
texts.g:14ec768c: Mulkiilaha dukaankaas wuxuu ahaa qof aad u naxariis badan.
texts.g:a6547036: Shalay dalka ma qaadan, sidaa darteed roob ayaa igu da'ay.
texts.g:fd3dd07a: Caano ayaa aad loogu jeclaa walaalkay yar xilligii ilmanimada.
texts.g:c29e438b: Maanta waxay ahayd maalin runtii mashquul badan. Subaxdii goor dambe ayaan tooday oo basaskii ayaa igu duuday. Sidaas darteed dugsiga ayaan daahay. Fiidkii saaxiib ayaa soo wacay oo saac ayaan hadalnay. Aad baan u daalay, laakiin si fiican ayaan u dareemay.
texts.g:f167da4a:
A: Shalay riwaayaddii muusigga ma aadday?
B: Haa, laakiin dad aad u badan ayaa joogay oo kursi ma jirin.
A: Markaas taagan ayaad daawatay?
B: Haa, laba saacadood ayaan taagnaa. Lugahaygu way xanuunayeen.
texts.n:k.k5.plans:planA: Dhammaadka mustaqbalka/qorshaha wuxuu ku xirmaa xididka falka: shaqal isku xira ayaa lagu daraa ka dib xidid ku dhammaada shibbane, mid kalena ma jiro ka dib xidid ku dhammaada shaqal.
texts.n:k.k5.plans:planB: Xididdada ku dhammaada shibbaneha u eg 'l' waxay ka tuuraan ka hor dhammaadkan.
texts.n:k.k5.plans:planC: Erayga diidmada wuxuu yimaadaa ka hor falka, dhammaadka qorshahuna wuxuu ku jiraa dhammaadka.
texts.g:a5f7ade4: Dhammaadka usbuuca waxaan la tegi doonaa saaxiib wax iibsi.
texts.g:0b6a26ab: Usbuuca dambe waxaan qaadan doonaa imtixaan Kuuriyaan ah.
texts.g:911417e9: Fiidkii waxaan wada cuni doonaa casho qoyskayga.
texts.g:ba69bd2c: Caawa waan seexan doonaa goor hore.
texts.g:4b9e7f3e: Sannadka dambe waxaan ka shaqayn doonaa Kuuriya.
texts.g:4edbe1dc: Berri subaxdii waan toosi doonaa goor hore.

texts.n:k.k7.cause_contrast:ccDo: -는데도 / -(으)ㄴ데도 macnaheedu waa 'inkasta oo'; isticmaal -는데도 fal iyo 있다/없다 ka dib, iyo -(으)ㄴ데도 tilmaame ka dib.
texts.n:k.k7.cause_contrast:ccTense: Waqtiga la soo dhaafay wuxuu yimaadaa -는데도 ka hor (-았/었는데도), weligiis -느라고 ka hor.
texts.g:9ef2ce1e: Ma cuni karin sababtoo ah waan wax baranayay.
texts.g:26d81a2e: Ma seexan karin sababtoo ah shaqada guriga ayaan sameynayay.
texts.g:d3f59594: Wicitaankii waan seegay sababtoo ah waxaan la hadlayay saaxiib.
texts.g:7beff67c: Shaqada guriga ma sameynin sababtoo ah ciyaaro ayaan ciyaarayay.
texts.g:41e4d3c5: Gurmadkii ma maqlin sababtoo ah muusig ayaan dhegaysanayay.
texts.g:364faf7c: Goor dambe ayaan toosay sababtoo ah waxaan akhrinayay ilaa goor dambe.
texts.g:5e505523: Ma daawan karin filimka sababtoo ah sawirro ayaan qaadayay.
texts.g:f651fbce: Shaqada guriga ma sameyn karin sababtoo ah waxaan daryeelayay walaalkay yar.
texts.g:8056419a: Maalmahan waan mashquulsanahay sababtoo ah waxaan u diyaargarowayaa imtixaanka.
texts.g:90bda6ce: Inkasta oo barafku da'ayo, dad badan ayaa jira.
texts.g:5c0373ea: Inkasta oo aan si adag wax u bartay, imtixaanka si xun ayaan u sameeyay.
texts.g:cb5e7efb: Inkasta oo aan wax badan cunay, waan gaajaysanahay.
texts.g:585c4876: Inkasta oo qabow yahay, dibadda ayaan ku jimicsadaa.
texts.g:2a3e9897: Inkasta oo aan daawo cabbay, madaxaygu wuu xanuunayaa.
texts.g:3e8ec4a0: Inkasta oo aanan lacag lahayn, dhar qaali ah ayaan iibsaday.
texts.g:b3d22f67: Inkasta oo aan marar badan ku celceliyo, Kuuriyaanku waa adag yahay.
texts.g:3fe28e49: Inkasta oo macallinku sharaxay, wali si fiican uma fahmin.
texts.g:52ffafb3: Inkasta oo qiimuhu sarreeyo, dad badan ayaa jira.
texts.g:860b3d40: Inkasta oo aan jirran ahaa, dugsiga ayaan tegay.
texts.g:11e1bd8c: Inkasta oo aan waqti badan lahaa, shaqada guriga ma sameynin.
texts.g:e673b929: Inkasta oo habeen yahay, dibadda waa iftiin.
texts.g:01f67f43: Inkasta oo aan goor hore toosay, waan raagay.
texts.g:495c1083: Inkasta oo uu/ay gaaban yahay, kubbadda koleyga si fiican ayuu/ay u ciyaaraa.
texts.g:42036d3e: Inta badan ma tegi karin kulamada naadiga sababtoo ah waxaan ka shaqayn jiray waqti-qayb.
texts.g:52095e69: Xitaa marka waddadu ay isku buuqdo, baska had iyo jeer wakhtigiisii ayuu yimaadaa.
texts.g:5faa16d2: Xitaa quraacdii ayaan iloobay inaan cuno sababtoo ah waxaan qorayay warbixin.
texts.g:719d03b9: In kasta oo aan xirtay jaakad qaro weyn, dabayshu way qabow tahay oo waan gariiray.
texts.g:b3b8105a: In kasta oo gurigeennu yar yahay, saaxiibbo badan ayaa inoo imaan jira.
texts.g:b3e57de1: Sababtoo ah waxaan caawinayay shaqaale kale, ma dhammaystiri karin shaqadaydii ka hor wakhtiga xidhitaanka.
texts.n:k.k7.indirect_ask:iaForm: Su'aalaha la xiganayo waxay isticmaalaan -냐고 (falalka, tilmaamayaasha, 있다/없다, wakhtiga hore -았/었냐고) iyo (이)냐고 magacyada, oo ay ku xigto 묻다 ama 하다.
texts.n:k.k7.indirect_ask:iaFut: Mustaqbalka waxaa lagu xigtaa -(으)ㄹ 거냐고; falalka ㄹ ayaa ㄹ ka tuuraan ka hor 냐고.
texts.g:b79e4e17: Saaxiibkay ayaa i weydiiyey haddii aan waqti haysto berri.
texts.g:3c1394df: Macallinka ayaa i weydiiyey xaggee ayaan aadayaa.
texts.g:65cf7f89: Walaalkay yar ayaa weydiiyey maxaan casho u cuneynaa.
texts.g:7dda07e8: Hooyo ayaa i weydiisay haddii aan cunay.
texts.g:b84f1fb3: Saaxiibkay ayaa weydiiyey haddii boorsadani qaali tahay.
texts.g:20c6a730: Ilmuhu wuxuu weydiiyey waxa tani tahay.
texts.g:3638fe4b: Qof ayaa weydiiyey haddii qofkaas arday yahay.
texts.g:80fa5426: Saaxiibkay ayaa i weydiiyey waxaan sameeyey dhammaadka toddobaadka.
texts.g:d71d9770: Walaasheey weyn ayaa weydiisay haddii berri roob da'i doono.
texts.g:88218694: Macallinka ayaa weydiiyey haddii af Kuuriyaanku adag yahay.
texts.g:cdc2daf9: Saaxiib ayaa i weydiiyey xaggee ku nool ahay.
texts.g:443faa87: Aabo ayaa weydiiyey goorma ayaan imaanayaa.
texts.g:a948d51b: Saaxiib ayaa i weydiiyey haddii aan filimka arkay.
texts.g:625b7936: Shaqaalaha dukaanka ayaa weydiiyey imisa qof ayaa jiray.
texts.g:6d482591: Walaalkay yar ayaa weydiiyey goorma ayaan tagay Kuuriya.
texts.g:b8dfc794: Saaxiib ayaa weydiiyey xaggee ayaan hadda joogaa.
texts.g:af8c6bfb: Hooyo ayaa weydiisay haddii aanan haysan shaqo guri.
texts.g:6c865ace: Macallinka ayaa weydiiyey maxaan u daahay.
texts.g:a92291f4: Saaxiib ayaa weydiiyey haddii aan jeclahay cuntada Kuuriya.
texts.g:db1ef2fb: Qof aan aqoon ayaa weydiiyey saacaddu imisa tahay hadda.
texts.g:6f6e9e32: Walaalkay yar ayaa weydiinaya haddii aan akhriyay buugan.
texts.g:50bcd2ac: Saaxiib ayaa weydiiyey haddii aan raacayo.
texts.g:3e9327b2: Saaxiib ayaa weydiiyey haddii cimiladu qabow tahay.
texts.g:13fd7256: Hooyo ayaa weydiinaysa haddii aan dhammaystiray shaqadayda guriga oo dhan.
texts.s:94ee4c60: Ma fahmin waxa qofka kale hadda yiri, waxaadna weydiisaa inuu mar kale ku celiyo.
texts.n:k.k7.indirect_cmd:icCmd: Amarka la xigtay waa -(으)라고 하다 (-으라고 ka dib shibbane, -라고 ka dib shaqal ama ㄹ); soo jeedinta la xigtay waa -자고 하다.
texts.n:k.k7.indirect_cmd:icNeg: Amarrada diidmada ee la xigtay waxay isticmaalaan -지 말라고, soo jeedinta diidmada na -지 말자고.
texts.n:k.k7.indirect_cmd:icL: Falalka ku dhammaada ㄹ waxay qaataan -라고, ma aha -으라고, amarrada la xigtay.
texts.g:48b37523: Macallinka ayaa noo sheegay inaan aamusno.
texts.g:fe54eb9b: Hooyo ayaa i tiri aan hurdo goor hore.
texts.g:7f4aad16: Saaxiib ayaa soo jeediyey inaan filim wada daawano.
texts.g:7aadb8bd: Dhakhtarku wuxuu igu yiri qaado daawada.
texts.g:8988d4b3: Aabbe wuxuu igu yiri xidh albaabka.
texts.g:95f00fd3: Saaxiib ayaa soo jeediyay inaan wada ordo dhammaadka usbuuca.
texts.g:8ee1eb97: Walaalkeyga yar ayaa soo jeediyay inaan wada qadeyno.
texts.g:0ad9a2ad: Saaxiib ayaa soo jeediyay inaan berri goor hore kulano.
texts.g:ad2f279a: Hooyo waxay igu tidhi marka hore qabo shaqada guriga.
texts.g:5b7dcfd5: Walaasheyda weyn waxay igu tidhi halkan sug.
texts.g:8ead5c5e: Macallinku ayaa noogu yiri ku hadal Kuuriyaan.
texts.g:7833997b: Saaxiib ayaa igu yiri aad gurigiisa ama gurigeeda.
texts.g:9caf299b: Dhakhtarku wuxuu igu yiri ha cabin khamri.
texts.g:07d5c44e: Saaxiib ayaa soo jeediyay inaynaan halkaas tagin.
texts.g:74a4739d: Macallinku ayaa igu yiri fur daaqadda.
texts.g:e733b4f4: Saaxiib ayaa soo jeediyay inaan wada qaadno sawir.
texts.g:9648456e: Hooyo waxay igu tidhi qaado dalladda roobka.
texts.g:f07c0449: Saaxiib ayaa soo jeediyay inaan wada barano maxaa yeelay berri imtixaan ayaa jira.
texts.g:3c2be032: Aabbe wuxuu igu yiri degdeg u toos.
texts.g:f33c6855: Macallinku ayaa noogu yiri eega sabuuradda.
texts.g:31689486: Saaxiib ayaa soo jeediyay inaan aadno qaxwo.
texts.g:ef26ef89: Macallinku ayaa noogu yiri furaa buugaagtiinna.
texts.n:k.k7.indirect_state:isVerb: Hadalka la soo sheego waxaa lagu sameeyaa -ㄴ/는다고 하다 falalka, -다고 tilmaame-erayada iyo 있다/없다, iyo (이)라고 magacyada.
texts.n:k.k7.indirect_state:isPast: Dhacdooyinka wakhtigii hore ama mustaqbalka waxaa la isticmaalaa -았/었다고 iyo -(으)ㄹ 거라고 ka hor 하다.

texts.g:225f876f: Minsu wuxuu yiri berri ayuu imanayaa.
texts.g:e569e54f: Saaxiibkay ayaa leh Kuuriyaanku waa adag yahay.
texts.g:e81b6ea2: Walaalkeyga yar ayaa yiri gaajo ayaa qabtay.
texts.g:21fcb0a7: Macallinku ayaa yiri berri imtixaan ayaa jira.
texts.g:487d2448: Hooyo waxay tidhi fiidkan roob ayaa da'ayaa.
texts.g:9b3d0a68: Aabbe wuxuu leeyahay hadda gaadhi ayuu wadaa.
texts.g:efc3d96a: Wuxuu leeyahay waa walaalka weyn ee saaxiibkay.
texts.g:85fefd8c: Saaxiibkay ayaa yiri shalay waa jiranaa.
texts.g:b98ff68a: Walaalkeyga yar ayaa leh shalay filim ayaa daawaday.
texts.g:abbc96cf: Saaxiibkay ayaa leh hadda way cunaysaa.
texts.g:2126721b: Walaasheyda weyn waxay leedahay maalin kasta way jimicsataa.
texts.g:bc93bac5: Wararku waxay yidhaahdeen berri baraf ayaa da'ayaa.
texts.g:c10b243d: Saaxiibkay ayaa yiri cuntada Kuuriyaanku waa macaan tahay.
texts.g:b7f3abde: Walaalkeyga yar ayaa yiri shaqo guri ma haysto.
texts.g:ef5d666f: Saaxiibkeyga ayaa leh maalmahan wuu mashquulsan yahay.
texts.g:2b7eded0: Saaxiibkay ayaa yiri maanta dugsiga ma tegayo.
texts.g:b5deb208: Walaalkeyga yar ayaa yiri guriga ayaa ku nool.
texts.g:aff3f5f2: Saaxiibkay ayaa leh ku nool Seoul.
texts.g:338de8dd: Saaxiibkay ayaa yiri qolku waa qabow yahay.
texts.g:d35c224e: Jisu waxay leedahay kimchi way jeceshahay.
texts.g:c68dea74: Ardaygu ayaa yiri rabaa inay barato Kuuriyaan.
texts.g:37f351a6: Ilmuhu wuxuu yidhi ma rabo inuu iskuulka tago.
texts.g:28bc5eb6:
A: Maxay Minsu u iman waysay?
B: Wuxuu yidhi maanta ma imaan karo sababtoo ah hargab buu qabaa.
texts.n:k.k7.pretense:prePres: -는 척하다 waxay la macno tahay 'iska dhig inaad (samaynayso)' falalka hadda iyo 있다/없다; isticmaal -(으)ㄴ 척하다 ka dib tilmaamayaasha iyo 이다.
texts.n:k.k7.pretense:prePast: Si aad u iska dhigto inaad wax horay u samaysay, isticmaal -(으)ㄴ 척하다 ee wakhtiga hore ee falka.

texts.g:f6bb5acc: Walaalkay yar wuxuu iska dhigaa inuu jirran yahay.
texts.g:82bf026e: Saaxiibkay wuxuu iska dhigay inuu dhammaystay shaqada guriga oo dhan.
texts.g:dd7effca: Qofkaasi wuxuu iska dhigaa inuu hodan yahay.
texts.g:3b763d6f: Waxaan iska dhigay inaanan arkin macallinka.
texts.g:25438304: Waxaan u dhaqmay sidii inaan fiicanahay, laakiin runtii waan murugaysnaa.
texts.g:46cfc26e: Saaxiibkay wuxuu iska dhigaa inuu Kuriyaanka ku fiican yahay.
texts.g:a4302604: Walaalkay yar wuxuu iska dhigaa inuu wax baranayo oo ciyaaraa ciyaaro.
texts.g:21e88863: Ardaygaasi wuxuu iska dhigay inuu fahmay wixii macallinku yidhi.
texts.g:aaa87976: Ilmuhu wuxuu iska dhigay inuusan ooyin.
texts.g:a28312c8: Saaxiibkay wuxuu iska dhigay inuusan maqlin wicitaanka telefoonka.
texts.g:43023d40: Walaalkay yar wuxuu iska dhigay inuusan cadhoonayn.
texts.g:6b3199be: Qofkaasi wuxuu iska dhigaa inuu naxariis leeyahay, laakiin runtii ma leh.
texts.g:577c64c2: Walaalkay yar wuxuu iska dhigaa inuu qof weyn yahay.
texts.g:8b881838: Ilmuhu wuxuu iska dhigay inaanu jirran.
texts.g:30947284: Walaalkay weyn wuxuu u dhaqmaa sidii inaan waxba dhicin.
texts.g:fef6dbdd: Waxaan iska dhigay inaan daawada cabbay.
texts.g:a0d420c7: Saaxiibkay wuxuu iska dhigay inuu bixiyay lacagta.
texts.g:01310541: Waxaan iska dhigay inaan dhoolla caddeeyay, laakiin gudahayga waan xumaaday.
texts.g:dfc2a254: Walaalkay yar wuxuu iska dhigaa oo keliya inuu nadiifinayo, kadibna wuu ciyaaraa.
texts.g:65a2e944: Saaxiibkay wuxuu iska dhigay inuu tegay Kuuriya.
texts.g:cf59e641: Walaalkay yar wuxuu iska dhigay inuu goor hore tooday.

texts.g:d3be5d3e: Markaan Kuriyaanka sii barto, waa sii farxad badan yahay.
texts.g:2ae3774f: Markaan cuno snacks-kan badan, ayaan sii rabaa inaan cuno.
texts.g:73801adf: Markaad sii weynaato, waqtigu wuu sii dhaqso yahay.
texts.g:332cf501: Markaad saaxiib la sii hadasho, ayaad sii dhowaataan.
texts.g:475f015d: Markaad sii kor u baxdo, waa sii qabow yahay.
texts.g:7dc9976f: Qiimaha markuu sii jaban yahay, waa sii wanaagsan yahay.
texts.g:295c7c60: Masaafada markay sii fog tahay, kharashka taxiga ayaa sii sarreeya.
texts.g:289bc365: Markay sii adkaato, waa inaad sii adkaysataa shaqada.
texts.g:2a7ba973: Cimiladu markay sii qabow tahay, shaaha kulul waa sii macaan yahay.
texts.g:91e2713c: Marka aad aad u dhegaysato, ayaa heesta ay sii fiicnaato.
texts.g:333a7225: Marka aan aad u isticmaalo, ayay sii raaxo badnaataa.
texts.g:2a103eaa: Marka aan aad u tababaro, ayaan sii fiicnaadaa.
texts.g:bed395b8: Inta aad goor hore tagto ayay ka fiicantahay.
texts.g:a731242e: Marka ay weyn tahay, ayay sii qaali tahay.
texts.g:8006715c: Haddii aad si adag u shaqeyso, natiijooyin wanaagsan ayaa xaqiiq ah inay raacaan.
texts.g:60cfdbaf: Ka dib marka jiilaalku dhaafo, gu'gu waa inuu yimaadaa.
texts.g:3b456729: Markii hore, waa dabiici in qof walba u arko mid adag.
texts.g:25e02160: Waxyaabuhu waa inay burburaan haddii muddo dheer la isticmaalo.
texts.g:2e672e30: Carruurtu waa inay si degdeg ah u koraan.
texts.g:ef377813: Marka roob da'o, waddooyinku waa inay xirmaan.
texts.g:c556748c: Haddii aad goor dambe seexato, waa inaad daalan tahay.
texts.g:b6a0f709: Wax kasta waa inay leeyihiin dhammaad.
texts.g:0755d7bf: Lacagtu waa inay ka dhammaato marka la kharash gareeyo.
texts.n:k.k7.regret:rgForm: Xididka falka + -(으)ㄹ 걸 그랬어요 wuxuu muujiyaa qoomamo wax aanad samayn ('Waxay ahayd inaan ...').
texts.n:k.k7.regret:rgNeg: Isticmaal -지 말 걸 그랬어요 si aad u tidhaahdo 'Waxaan ahaa inaanan ...' wax aad samaysay.
texts.n:k.k7.regret:reg: -(으)ㄹ 걸 그랬어요 wuxuu muujiyaa qoomamo wax aanad samayn. Wax aad samaysay oo hadda ka qoomamaysid, isticmaal -지 말 걸 그랬어요. Falka ka hor 걸 had iyo jeer waa qaabka -(으)ㄹ.

texts.g:b1e254c9: Tirada cabashooyinka macmiilka si weyn ayay hoos ugu dhacday marka loo eego bishii hore.
texts.g:47a193f5: Kharashku wuxuu ka sarreeyay sida la filayay, sidaa darteed hagaajinta miisaaniyadda lama iska ilaalin karo.
texts.g:31d248bb: Waxaan habeeyay natiijooyinka tijaabada hore oo waxaan u soo sheegay hoggaamiyaha kooxda.
texts.g:b5e19486: Hadafyada la qorsheeyay dhammaantood ma gaarin, laakiin waxaan dhammaystirnay hawlaha ugu muhiimsan.
texts.g:6bbe6a0d: Falanqaynta isbeddelka iibka rubuca sannadka waxay muujinaysaa in jihada kororka ay cadaatay markii qaybta labaad bilaabatay.
texts.g:685e1961: Sida uu muujiyay dib-u-eegistu, waxaa la go'aamiyay in fududaynta habraaca hadda jira ay badhkii ku dhimi karto waqtiga habaynta.
texts.g:61789bd5: Heerka fulinta miisaaniyadda mashruucu waa hoos, sidaa darteed tallaabooyin dheeri ah waa in la diyaariyaa ka hor dhammaadka sannadka.
texts.g:be0ce06e: Sahankan waxaa lagu sameeyay 1,000 qof oo qaan-gaar ah oo da'doodu u dhaxeyso labaatankii ilaa lixdankii.
texts.g:135d2195: Dhammaadka warbixinta waxaan soo koobay oo lifaaq ku daray hawlaha mustaqbalka iyo jihooyinka hagaajinta.
texts.g:f567fa5f: Waxaan soo gudbinayaa xaaladda maaraynta weydiimaha macaamiisha ee Rubuca 3aad. Wadarta weydiimuhu waxay ahaayeen 2,400, oo 8 boqolley ka badan rubucii hore, laakiin celceliska waqtiga maaraynta waxaa laga dhimay laba maalmood ilaa hal. Tani waxaa lagu falanqeeyay inay tahay natiijada weydiimaha fudud oo hoos u dhacay ka dib markii su'aalaha inta badan la weydiiyo lagu abaabulay boggaga caawimaadda. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, weydiimaha la xiriira lacag-celinta ayaa kordhay, sidaas darteed qorshe jawaab gooni ah ayaa loo baahan yahay. Rubuca 4aad waxaan qorsheynaynaa inaan marka hore hagaajino hagidda habraaca lacag-celinta.
texts.g:85123a65: Qoraalka shirka dib-u-eegista mashruuca ee 3aad. Ajendaha wuxuu ahaa dib u dhigidda jadwalka beddelidda nidaamka hawo-marinta dhismaha xafiiska. Qandaraasleyuhu wuxuu ka warbixiyay in qaybaha ay goor dambe yimaadeen iyo inuu dib u dhigayo bilowga dhismaha laba toddobaad. Jawaabta, maareeyaha arrimaha guud wuxuu aqbalay dib u dhigidda isagoo ku salaynaya in shaqada la dhammaystiri doono ka hor hubinta dhammaadka sannadka, laakiin wuxuu go'aamiyay in haddii taariikhda la filayo ee dhammaadku mar kale dib u dhacdo, habraaca doorashada qandaraasle beddel ah isla markiiba la bilaabi doono. Xubnuhu waxay isku raaceen in shuruudan qandaraasleyaha si qoran loogu sheego. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, cidda mas'uulka ka ah yimaaddada dambe ee qaybaha shirkan lama xalin.
texts.g:bb2fd3a9: Ogeysiis ku saabsan isbeddelka khidmadaha baarkinka dadweynaha. Laga bilaabo 1da bisha soo socota, khidmadda aasaasiga ah waxaa laga hagaajin doonaa 600 won ilaa 800 won 30 daqiiqo kasta. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, khidmaddii hore ayaa lagu dabaqi doonaa gawaarida diiwaangashan ee baarkinka mudnaanta degganayaasha iyo gawaarida muujinaya ogolaansho naafo. Xataa gawaarida diiwaangashan, marka isticmaalka bishii uu ka badan yahay 100 saacadood, khidmadda la hagaajiyay waxay khusaysaa oo keliya inta dheeraadka ah. Dakhliga dheeraadka ah ee isbeddelku wuxuu loo isticmaali doonaa oo keliya dayactirka xarumaha, isticmaalka faahfaahsan ee lacagtana waxaa lagu soo bandhigi doonaa shabakadda dhammaadka sannadka.
texts.g:049bc42e: Warbixinta hubinta gudaha. Baaritaan muunad ah oo ah afartan qandaraas iibsiga alaabta ee badhkii hore ee sannadkan, lix iyo soddon ayaa raacay habraaca. Afarta hadhay, sababta qandaraaska aan tartanka lahayn ayaa la qoray ka dib markii qandaraaska la saxiixay, laakiin maadaama qiimaha qandaraasyadu dhammaantood ka hooseeyeen xadka, looma tixgelinayo inay jebiyeen xeerarka. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, si qoritaanka dhacdada ka dib uusan u noqon caado, waaxda mas'uulka ahi waa inay sababta ansixiso qandaraaska ka hor laga bilaabo rubuca soo socda. Kooxda hubintu waxay mar kale hubin doontaa u hoggaansanaanta dhammaadka rubuca.
texts.g:976a9aaa: Kooban daqiiqadaha ka dood miisaaniyadda badhka labaad. Waaxda R&D waxay codsatay kororka 400 milyan won oo kharashka iibsiga qalabka. Guddiga maaliyaddu ma ansixin tirada codsiga oo dhan; wuxuu marka hore qoondeeyay 200 milyan won wuxuuna go'aansaday in inta soo hartay si dheeraad ah loo tixgeliyo oo keliya haddii heerka isticmaalka qalabka sannadkan uu ka badiyo 70 boqolkiiba. Guddoomiyuhu wuxuu waaxda R&D weydiistay inay diyaariso, kulanka xiga ka hor, shuruudaha sida heerka isticmaalka loo xisaabin doono. Waaxda R&D mucaarad gaar ah ma soo bandhigin.
texts.g:ae29c713: Xaaladda dadaallada lagu gaabinayo waqtiga habaynta ogolaanshaha. Celceliska waqtiga habaynta sannadkan wuxuu ahaa 41 maalmood, 9 maalmood ka gaaban sannadkii hore. Dhibaatada waqtiga habaynta weli waxay ku jirtaa marxaladda la-tashiga saamaynta deegaanka, taasoo ka kooban 60 boqolkiiba kiisaska daahay oo dhan. Waaxda mas'uulka ahi waxay tijaabin doontaa qorshe lagu maareeyo nidaamyada la-tashiga isla mar, laakiin ma gaabin doonto muddada dib-u-eegista sharciga. Waqtiga laga helay maaraynta isla markaasta ah waa in lagu helo yaraynta inta jeer ee codsiyada dhammaystirka dukumiintiyada codsiga la soo celceliyo. Sidaa darteed saamaynta gaabinta ayaa aad ugu xirnaan doonta in dukumiintiyada si buuxda looga gudbiyo bilowga.
texts.g:d3bd3f83: Warbixinta xaaladaha iyo tallaabooyinka kadib shil taabasho forklift ee xarunta qaybinta. Intii lagu jiray shaqada habeenka bishii hore, forklift ayaa taabtay shaqaale aagga rarista, laakiin shaqaaluhu wuxuu helay oo keliya nabar yar. Baadhitaanku wuxuu helay in darawalku ilaaliyay xawaaraha la qeexay iyo in xaaladda dayactirka forklift-kuna ay fiicnayd. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, aagga iftiinkiisu yaryahay marinka lugeynta iyo marinka gaadiidka lama kala sooci. Xaruntu waxay go'aamisay in sababta tooska ahi tahay cilad naqshadeynta socodka gaadiidka halkii ay ka ahaan lahayd dayac shaqsi, waxayna go'aansatay inayan darawalka ciqaabin. Taa beddelkeeda, waxay dhammaystiri doontaa kala-saarista marinnada laba bilood gudahood, ilaa markaas na waxay xaddidi doontaa shaqada habeenka ee aagga.
texts.g:6c39236a: Mowqifka ku saabsan shakiga ah in diiwaannada gelitaanka xogta ay dhaceen. Machadka Hangyeol ayaa ku dhawaaqay in, sida ay sheegtay hubinta shirkad amni oo dibadda ah, la xaqiijiyay calaamado muujinaya in diiwaannada gelitaanka qaar ka mid ah cilmi-baarayaasha laga eegay dibadda Maarso hore. Hase yeeshee, weli lama xaqiijin in diiwaannada la eegay ay ku jireen macluumaad shakhsi ah oo aqoonsi, hadda ma jiraan xaalado dhaawac ah oo la helay. Machadku wuxuu yidhi wuxuu daabici doonaa natiijooyinka isla marka xaqiijintu dhammaato, haddii la ogaado in macluumaad aqoonsi ay ku jirtay, si gaar ah ayuu ugu ogeysiin doonaa dadka la xiriira. Intaa waxaa dheer, wuxuu qorsheeyay dib-u-eegis dhammaystiran oo nidaamka maamulka ogolaanshaha gelitaanka ah natiijada dhacdadan.
texts.g:b9e90e9f: Hubintu waxay heshay qaar ka mid ah walxo xadka dhaafay, sidaa darteed waxaa la codsaday tallaabo hagaajin.
texts.g:d46e1f08: Hoos waxaan ku warbixinayaa sababaha ay heerka fulinta miisaaniyaddu uga hoosaysay bartilmaameedka iyo qorshaha lagu buuxinayo.
texts.g:85605a8f: Haddii shuruudaha heshiiska la beddelo, ogeysiis qoran waa in horey loo bixiyo.
texts.g:39648128: Tallaabadan waa ku-meel-gaar, siyaasadda ugu dambeysana waxaa la xaqiijin doonaa kadib dood qaadista guddiga.
texts.g:a0aa709a: Haddii wax is beddel ah ka jiro kuwa kor ku xusan, fadlan isla markiiba la xiriir waaxda mas'uulka ah.
texts.g:fea2fcff: Haddii wax aan caadi ahayn la helo inta tijaabada socoto, waa inaad isla markiiba joojisaa hawlgalka oo u warbixisaa qofka mas'uulka ah.
texts.g:a39dd73a: Arrinta waxaa lagu xalliyay si waafaqsan sharciyada khuseeya, mana jirin ismaan-dhaaf gaar ah oo la soo bandhigay.
texts.g:4631c1a2: Waxaan ku talinayaa in qorshahan hagaajinta la hakiyo sababtoo ah saameyntiisa kaydinta kharashka way yar tahay, laakiin mar dambe dib loo eego.

texts.g:017cde72: Waan ka raali galayaa isbeddelka lama filaanka ah.

texts.s:ac6a7e12: Jadwalku weli ma dhammaystirna oo waxaad ballan qaadaysaa inaad dhinaca kale ogeysiiso.
texts.g:87ecb213: Ma dib u dhigi karnaa toddobaadka soo socda?
texts.s:87ecb213: Waxaad weydiisaa in shir la dib u dhigi karo.
texts.g:9ac09f78: Shirka waxaan dib ugu dhigayaa Talaadada soo socota.
texts.g:298f58b0: Ma ku habboonaan lahayd haddii laga beddelo saddexda galabnimo una beddelo afarta galabnimo?
texts.g:e0738fa2: Waan go'aamin doonaa ka dib markaan hubiyo jadwalka ka qaybgalayaasha.
texts.g:a0170490: Waan ka xumahay, laakiin waxaan u malaynayaa inaan baajiyo ballanka galabta.
texts.g:52e14d58: Fadlan soo gudbi agabka ilaa Jimcaha.
texts.g:dff4a481: Waan ka xumahay inaanan hore kuu sheegin.
texts.g:217ab817: Haddii aad ii sheegto waqtiga aad doorbidayso, waan la qabsan doonaa.
texts.g:3c66ccf6: Sababtoo ah safar shaqo, booqashadii waxaan hormarinay hal toddobaad.
texts.g:dd23c0b3: Ma u wareejin karnaa waqtiga shirka subaxda?
texts.g:7a9b44f9:
A: Ma ku habboon tahay shir Arbacada soo socota?
B: Arbacadu way adag tahay. Maxaa ka khusayn Khamiista galabnimo?

B: Markaa waan go'aamin doonaa waqtigaas.
texts.g:d1e2b533:
Kaaliyaha Maareeyaha Park,
Shirkii berrito la qorsheeyay waa la dib u dhigay Jimcaha sababo aan laga fogaan karin.
Waan ka cudurdaartaa dhibka ka dhashay isbeddelkan degdegga ah.
Jadwalka cusub: Jimcaha, 10 subaxnimo, Qolka Shirarka B.
texts.g:e8018514: Shirka berri subaxdii waa la baajiyay sababo la xiriira xaaladda waaxda.
texts.g:ae464506: Qofka mas'uulka ahi wuxuu ku maqan yahay safar shaqo, markaa waa inaan wareysiga dib u dhigno ilaa bisha soo socota.
texts.g:7750577b: Wakhtiga kama dambaysta ah hal maalin ayaa la kordhiyay, markaa jadwalka soo gudbinta wax yar ayaa hawo ah.
texts.g:6604f20c:
Maareeyaha Lee,
Booqashadii macmiilka ee Talaadada soo socota loo qabtay waa la hagaajiyay.
Qofka macmiilka xiriirka la leh wuxuu safar shaqo ku leeyahay Talaadada, sidaas darteed wuxuu soo jeediyay Khamiista subaxdii.
Haddii taasi kugu habboon tahay, waan xaqiijin doonaa Khamiista subaxnimo saacadda tobnaad.
Fadlan ii sheeg haddii ay shaqaynayso ilaa Arbacada subaxdii.
Choi Ha-neul

texts.g:c771b74d: Saamiga suuqa wuxuu ka kacay 20 boqolkiiba illaa 25 boqolkiiba.
texts.g:a51be2d2: Dhoofintu waxay ku jirtaa jiho kobac joogto ah.

texts.g:636aab76: Sahankan, 60 boqolkiiba jawaabayaasha ayaa ku qanacsanaa alaabta.
